chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: The trio becomes a singing act: Marie's idea
summary: At the Tiffany Nat Cole became a stand-up singer, which Collins and Willard agree was Marie's idea.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Were you in the beginning when you first went with him, were you ever featured or get any credit? (inaudible).
Well, for a fleeting moment I got in on the tailend of the Nat Cole trio. But at this time he --
as you know, where was I worked -- the Tiffany.
Yeah, and he had started -- he had the idea of becoming a standup singer.
Would you say that that wasn't Nat's idea. I mean, I remember back to when I first met you, that it was Marie's idea?
That Marie had decided that five men would not be identified, the five men would not be featured.
